title: Beehive Data API
description: Query format latency, completions, failures, throughput, SSE, reader renewal and process health. Original metric families retained.

panels.title: Target availability
panels.description: Prometheus reachability, not proof of successful Influx/Pelican reads.

panels.title: Queries in progress
panels.description: Includes backend lock waiting, setup, streaming and result cleanup.

panels.title: Completed query rate
panels.description: Handler completions per second, including rejected and failed requests.

panels.title: Query failure fraction
panels.description: Failure fraction among finished non-invalid, non-canceled handlers; cleanup errors are operational failures even if the HTTP body was complete.

panels.title: Query completions by format and outcome
panels.description: A stream error can retain HTTP status 200; use outcome as well as status.

panels.title: HTTP statuses observed by query handler
panels.description: Status is observed at this handler, not a proxy status. none means panic before headers.

panels.title: In-progress query handlers
panels.description: In-progress query handlers

panels.title: Queries observed within selected range
panels.description: Counters reset on process restart; events before the first scrape cannot be reconstructed.

panels.title: First accepted body bytes p50
panels.description: Server response writer acceptance, not client receipt or first decoded Arrow batch. Arrow schema bytes may precede rows; empty NDJSON has no sample.

panels.title: First accepted body bytes p95
panels.description: Includes initial query/fetch and first write blocking; can include responses that later fail.

panels.title: Successful full handler duration p50
panels.description: Through result cleanup/read-grant release; not client dataframe completion.

panels.title: Successful full handler duration p95
panels.description: Tail estimates need enough completed observations; includes cleanup.

panels.title: Backend Query setup average
panels.description: Query call can include backend lock waiting, routing and setup. Deferred native scan/fetch work may happen after this call returns.

panels.title: Result close average
panels.description: Resource closure, including dynamic read-grant release. A close error is an operational failure, not proof that an already written body is incomplete.

panels.title: Latency observation samples
panels.description: Check sample count before interpreting p95. No nonempty HTTP 200 body means no sample.

panels.title: Legacy latency separated by format
panels.description: Same observation points as legacy: Arrow before IPC encoding, NDJSON before first row write. These points have different meanings.

panels.title: Original combined latency (all formats)
panels.description: Original metric name, type, buckets and timing preserved. This panel intentionally ignores format selection.

panels.title: Rows reported by successful encoders
panels.description: Updated at handler completion, not a live row counter. Successful encoder count is not an acknowledgement from the client.

panels.title: Accepted response body bytes
panels.description: Updates in 64 KiB increments and at exit. Includes error bodies; excludes HTTP headers/TCP framing and proxy transformations.

panels.title: Successful response size p95
panels.description: Arrow values reflect its configured IPC compression. Not storage scan bytes.

panels.title: Successful result rows average
panels.description: Rows processed per successful handler; empty extracts contribute zero.

panels.title: Observed errors by stage
panels.description: Stages are request, parse, backend, encode, iterate, write, close, panic. One request may produce multiple errors; cancellations are excluded.

panels.title: Invalid requests and canceled queries
panels.description: Canceled includes caller cancellation/deadline or a typed lost read lease; do not combine with backend failure rate automatically.

panels.title: Resource close errors
panels.description: Resource close errors

panels.title: Failure duration average
panels.description: Failure duration average

panels.title: Live SSE (format filter does not apply)
Active SSE handlers (legacy gauge)
panels.description: Retained legacy gauge despite _total suffix. Includes GET/Flusher-supported broker setup attempts.

panels.title: SSE connection starts
panels.description: Setup attempts, not only established subscriptions.

panels.title: Ended SSE sessions
panels.description: Client cancellation is normal termination; failed setup and broker closures are distinct outcomes.

panels.title: SSE broker delivery outcomes
panels.description: written means event written/flushed without error, not client acknowledgement; filtered/invalid deliveries remain separate.

panels.title: SSE errors by stage
panels.description: Includes malformed broker payloads and closed subscription/write/flush failures.

panels.title: SSE accepted body bytes
panels.description: Includes events and heartbeats; does not prove client receipt.

panels.title: SSE heartbeats
panels.description: SSE heartbeats

panels.title: Ended SSE session duration average
panels.description: Duration samples appear when a session ends; does not measure current connection age.

panels.title: Dynamic reader renewal (format filter does not apply)
Read renewal outcomes
panels.description: API-side observations include transport and invalid-view failures. Canceled requests remain separate.

panels.title: Read renewal duration p95
panels.description: Background renewal latency does not extend the confirmed lease; API or coordinator outage can cancel active queries.

panels.title: Process and Go runtime (format filter does not apply)
Process CPU (Go and native DuckDB)
panels.description: Whole API process, including embedded DuckDB worker threads. Not total container/cgroup CPU.

panels.title: Process RSS (Go and native DuckDB)
panels.description: Whole process resident memory, including embedded DuckDB; not container limit/charged file cache. May be absent on unsupported platforms.

panels.title: Go heap allocated
panels.description: Go managed heap only; difference from RSS is not a precise DuckDB memory measurement.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines

panels.title: Average GC pause
panels.description: Average GC pause

panels.title: Process uptime
panels.description: Process uptime

panels.title: Runtime configuration and build (format filter does not apply)
Frontier and Arrow compression
panels.description: Startup settings: hot, static or dynamic frontier and configured Arrow IPC codec. This does not select a query response format.

panels.title: API build
panels.description: Build metadata for rollout comparison; unknown is allowed when VCS information is unavailable.

panels.title: Oldest active handler age by format
panels.description: Includes backend waiting, streaming and result cleanup. Zero/idle timestamps are hidden; this is not a SQL-only duration or a progress heartbeat.
